stages.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: one museum catalogue portrait, vertical 4:5 head and upper shoulders. Draw Huygens recognizably after image 1, preserving his three-quarter head angle, slim youthful long face, long nose, closed lips, clean-shaven chin, abundant long curled hair and historical lace neckcloth and coat. Retain the full documented crown with a modest blank margin. Crop above hands; no chair, props or scenery. Match the museum style: economical near-black pen on flat warm ivory #f7f6f0. Fine, subtly varied outlines, lighter over the crown, firmer on the shadow side; fine internal contours. Give curls and coat tone with restrained directional hatching and a few dark masses. Only essential eye, brow, nostril, mouth and face contours. No text, border, signature or frame. This is an illustration after the named painting, not a newly imagined historical face.
